headline: Bay depression may develop into cyclone Arnab
summary: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department warns of a deep depression that could intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm heading toward India's coast.
details: A deep depression over the Bay of Bengal has intensified and could develop into a cyclone, according to the Bangladesh Meteorological Department.
If the system strengthens, it will be named 'Arnab', a name proposed by Bangladesh meaning 'ocean' or 'sea'.
The system is currently centered south of Chattogram, Cox's Bazar, Mongla, and Payra ports, with sustained winds of 50km per hour and gusts up to 60km per hour.
The Meteorological Department forecasts that the system may move north-westwards and intensify into a cyclone on Monday.
It is expected to potentially cross India's Andhra coast as a very severe cyclonic storm by Wednesday.
Chattogram, Cox's Bazar, Mongla, and Payra ports have been advised to keep hoisting distant warning Signal No. 1.
All fishing boats and trawlers in the northern Bay of Bengal have been instructed to move closer to the coast and navigate with caution.

headline: 3 three men jailed for life for raping woman on moving bus
summary: The Tangail Women and Children Repression Prevention Tribunal has sentenced three individuals to life imprisonment for the crime.
details: The Tangail Women and Children Repression Prevention Tribunal has sentenced three men to life imprisonment for raping a woman on a moving bus. Each convict was also fined 1 lakh BDT, with an additional year of imprisonment if the fine is not paid.
The convicts are identified as bus driver Md. Altaf, contractor Sagar (alias Sajib Matubbar), and Md. Rabing.
According to the case, the victim boarded a Savar Transport bus from Gabtoli to Ashulia on January 14, 2026. She was raped on the moving bus in the Chandra area of Gazipur early the next morning.
The attackers also snatched her gold jewelry, mobile phone, and cash. The three suspects were later arrested by highway police in the Kortia area of Tangail.
Public Prosecutor Omrao Khan Dipu stated that the fines imposed on the convicts will be paid to the victim as compensation.
caption:
Three men receive life sentences after raping a woman on a moving bus and stealing her belongings.

The Tangail Women and Children Repression Prevention Tribunal has sentenced three men to life imprisonment for raping a woman on a moving bus. Each convict was also fined 1 lakh BDT, with an additional year of imprisonment if the fine is not paid.

The convicts are identified as bus driver Md. Altaf, contractor Sagar (alias Sajib Matubbar), and Md. Rabing.

According to the case, the victim boarded a Savar Transport bus from Gabtoli to Ashulia on January 14, 2026. She was raped on the moving bus in the Chandra area of Gazipur early the next morning.

The attackers also snatched her gold jewelry, mobile phone, and cash. The three suspects were later arrested by highway police in the Kortia area of Tangail.

Public Prosecutor Omrao Khan Dipu stated that the fines imposed on the convicts will be paid to the victim as compensation.
